title: [The Jocular Oculist, Main Deck]
description: Swaying to and fro, near-white canvas sails flap noisily in the breeze, adding a calming distraction from the vessel's rushed crew members.  Red pine planking, laden with puddles from a recent washing, stretches across the deck in eye-catching patterns of mixed horizontal and vertical arrangements.  Thick braided ropes hang from brass hooks along the main mast which casts shadows across a wooden grate in the center of the main deck.  Adjacent to a red pine gangplank, some stairs lead down to the lower level.
